rca_of_issue: Original bug: user reported invite link returning raw {"detail":"not found"} JSON. RCA: link was in format /join/[token] (path param). When token contained certain chars (e.g. leading '-') or when WhatsApp auto-shortened URLs or in static-hosting scenarios, the dynamic segment routing could fail and expose the backend 404 JSON. Fix applied by main agent: (1) invite generator now emits /join?token=XYZ (query param — universal); (2) new app/join.tsx reads query param and calls api.getInvite; (3) both routes catch errors and render friendly 'Convite inválido' screen with testID='invite-notfound' instead of leaking JSON. Validated end-to-end: no raw 'detail' JSON is ever exposed to the user in any of the tested paths.
